dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: When did your eye become red, and which eye is affected?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: My left eye became red yesterday afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: There was also some sticky discharge around the eye when he woke up this morning.

dialogue.speaker: child
dialogue.text: You kept rubbing your eye during breakfast.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes. It feels very itchy and irritated.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Is your vision blurred or reduced in that eye?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No. My vision seems completely normal.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Is the eye painful, or does it mainly itch?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: It mainly itches. I would not describe it as painful.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: Nobody else at home has developed a red eye or similar symptoms.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No. I do not use contact lenses.

dialogue.speaker: child
dialogue.text: The eye looked more red after you rubbed it.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you had fever, headache, or severe sensitivity to light?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No fever, no headache, and normal light does not bother me.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: I will examine the surface of the eye and check for conjunctivitis or another cause.
